notes: Benchmark-derived skill vector for GPT-5.6 Terra (balanced tier, released 2026-07-09). OpenAI's launch suite is deliberately agentic and omits AIME/GPQA/MMLU/IFEval, so only coding and planning_agentic have direct public benchmarks (confidence high); math/world/instruction are anchored to the composite intelligence index (confidence medium); creative_synthesis is imputed (confidence low). Sourcing per dimension: coding=Terminal-Bench 2.1 87.4% + Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 77.4/100; planning_agentic=Agents' Last Exam 50.4; math_reasoning + world_knowledge + instruction_following=Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1 Terra=55 (no standalone AIME/GPQA/IFEval published); creative_synthesis=imputed as the mean of the known coordinates. Sources: openai.com/index/gpt-5-6, artificialanalysis.ai/articles/gpt-5-6-has-landed, vellum.ai/blog/gpt-5-6-benchmarks-explained. A `measured` extraction on the frozen probe set overrides this.
